description: repair a registered joseki card's lifecycle row so its stored knowledge-base path points at the canonical location; fixes a card whose row kept a pre-migration path after the card moved into the dedicated authored-joseki knowledge base.
embedding_description: Row maintenance for an authored joseki: normalise the stored knowledge-base path on its lifecycle record to the canonical card location. Repairs rows carrying a stale pre-migration path so downstream readers resolve the correct card. Idempotent — a row already pointing at the canonical path is left unchanged.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Reconciliation result with keys: joseki_key, previous_knowledge_base_path, knowledge_base_path, status
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Report the canonical knowledge_base_path; when status is 'reconciled' also surface the previous_knowledge_base_path that was repaired, and when 'unchanged' note the row was already canonical.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: The stored path now resolves the correct card. This is a bookkeeping repair; continue the current plan.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Reconciling the stored knowledge-base path on an authored joseki lifecycle row. reconcile_authored_joseki_row accepts {joseki_key}.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: JosekiNotFound: no lifecycle row exists for the key. StorageError: the state read or update failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Missing row: register the card first. Storage failures: retry once the platform reports healthy.
